text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm Almond Eye! Looking forward to working with you starting today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There is only one goal: "to win."
Even if I lose, I will win.
I'll win, win, and win—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even beyond legends, I'll keep on winning!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
